FILE: .git/hooks/commit-msg.sample
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/.git/hooks/commit-msg.sample
====================================================================================================
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to check the commit log message.
# Called by "git commit" with one argument, the name of the file
# that has the commit message.  The hook should exit with non-zero
# status after issuing an appropriate message if it wants to stop the
# commit.  The hook is allowed to edit the commit message file.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "commit-msg".

# Uncomment the below to add a Signed-off-by line to the message.
# Doing this in a hook is a bad idea in general, but the prepare-commit-msg
# hook is more suited to it.
#
# SOB=$(git var GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT | sed -n 's/^\(.*>\).*$/Signed-off-by: \1/p')
# grep -qs "^$SOB" "$1" || echo "$SOB" >> "$1"

# This example catches duplicate Signed-off-by lines.

test "" = "$(grep '^Signed-off-by: ' "$1" |
	 sort | uniq -c | sed -e '/^[ 	]*1[ 	]/d')" || {
	echo >&2 Duplicate Signed-off-by lines.
	exit 1
}

FILE: .git/hooks/fsmonitor-watchman.sample
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/.git/hooks/fsmonitor-watchman.sample
====================================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/perl

use strict;
use warnings;
use IPC::Open2;

# An example hook script to integrate Watchman
# (https://facebook.github.io/watchman/) with git to speed up detecting
# new and modified files.
#
# The hook is passed a version (currently 2) and last update token
# formatted as a string and outputs to stdout a new update token and
# all files that have been modified since the update token. Paths must
# be relative to the root of the working tree and separated by a single NUL.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "query-watchman" and set
# 'git config core.fsmonitor .git/hooks/query-watchman'
#
my ($version, $last_update_token) = @ARGV;

# Uncomment for debugging
# print STDERR "$0 $version $last_update_token\n";

# Check the hook interface version
if ($version ne 2) {
	die "Unsupported query-fsmonitor hook version '$version'.\n" .
	    "Falling back to scanning...\n";
}

my $git_work_tree = get_working_dir();

my $retry = 1;

my $json_pkg;
eval {
	require JSON::XS;
	$json_pkg = "JSON::XS";
	1;
} or do {
	require JSON::PP;
	$json_pkg = "JSON::PP";
};

launch_watchman();

sub launch_watchman {
	my $o = watchman_query();
	if (is_work_tree_watched($o)) {
		output_result($o->{clock}, @{$o->{files}});
	}
}

sub output_result {
	my ($clockid, @files) = @_;

	# Uncomment for debugging watchman output
	# open (my $fh, ">", ".git/watchman-output.out");
	# binmode $fh, ":utf8";
	# print $fh "$clockid\n@files\n";
	# close $fh;

	binmode STDOUT, ":utf8";
	print $clockid;
	print "\0";
	local $, = "\0";
	print @files;
}

sub watchman_clock {
	my $response = qx/watchman clock "$git_work_tree"/;
	die "Failed to get clock id on '$git_work_tree'.\n" .
		"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $? != 0;

	return $json_pkg->new->utf8->decode($response);
}

sub watchman_query {
	my $pid = open2(\*CHLD_OUT, \*CHLD_IN, 'watchman -j --no-pretty')
	or die "open2() failed: $!\n" .
	"Falling back to scanning...\n";

	# In the query expression below we're asking for names of files that
	# changed since $last_update_token but not from the .git folder.
	#
	# To accomplish this, we're using the "since" generator to use the
	# recency index to select candidate nodes and "fields" to limit the
	# output to file names only. Then we're using the "expression" term to
	# further constrain the results.
	my $last_update_line = "";
	if (substr($last_update_token, 0, 1) eq "c") {
		$last_update_token = "\"$last_update_token\"";
		$last_update_line = qq[\n"since": $last_update_token,];
	}
	my $query = <<"	END";
		["query", "$git_work_tree", {$last_update_line
			"fields": ["name"],
			"expression": ["not", ["dirname", ".git"]]
		}]
	END

	# Uncomment for debugging the watchman query
	# open (my $fh, ">", ".git/watchman-query.json");
	# print $fh $query;
	# close $fh;

	print CHLD_IN $query;
	close CHLD_IN;
	my $response = do {local $/; <CHLD_OUT>};

	# Uncomment for debugging the watch response
	# open ($fh, ">", ".git/watchman-response.json");
	# print $fh $response;
	# close $fh;

	die "Watchman: command returned no output.\n" .
	"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $response eq "";
	die "Watchman: command returned invalid output: $response\n" .
	"Falling back to scanning...\n" unless $response =~ /^\{/;

	return $json_pkg->new->utf8->decode($response);
}

sub is_work_tree_watched {
	my ($output) = @_;
	my $error = $output->{error};
	if ($retry > 0 and $error and $error =~ m/unable to resolve root .* directory (.*) is not watched/) {
		$retry--;
		my $response = qx/watchman watch "$git_work_tree"/;
		die "Failed to make watchman watch '$git_work_tree'.\n" .
		    "Falling back to scanning...\n" if $? != 0;
		$output = $json_pkg->new->utf8->decode($response);
		$error = $output->{error};
		die "Watchman: $error.\n" .
		"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $error;

		# Uncomment for debugging watchman output
		# open (my $fh, ">", ".git/watchman-output.out");
		# close $fh;

		# Watchman will always return all files on the first query so
		# return the fast "everything is dirty" flag to git and do the
		# Watchman query just to get it over with now so we won't pay
		# the cost in git to look up each individual file.
		my $o = watchman_clock();
		$error = $output->{error};

		die "Watchman: $error.\n" .
		"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $error;

		output_result($o->{clock}, ("/"));
		$last_update_token = $o->{clock};

		eval { launch_watchman() };
		return 0;
	}

	die "Watchman: $error.\n" .
	"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $error;

	return 1;
}

sub get_working_dir {
	my $working_dir;
	if ($^O =~ 'msys' || $^O =~ 'cygwin') {
		$working_dir = Win32::GetCwd();
		$working_dir =~ tr/\\/\//;
	} else {
		require Cwd;
		$working_dir = Cwd::cwd();
	}

	return $working_dir;
}

FILE: .git/hooks/pre-commit.sample
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/.git/hooks/pre-commit.sample
====================================================================================================
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to verify what is about to be committed.
# Called by "git commit" with no arguments.  The hook should
# exit with non-zero status after issuing an appropriate message if
# it wants to stop the commit.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "pre-commit".

if git rev-parse --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1
then
	against=HEAD
else
	# Initial commit: diff against an empty tree object
	against=$(git hash-object -t tree /dev/null)
fi

# If you want to allow non-ASCII filenames set this variable to true.
allownonascii=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allownonascii)

# Redirect output to stderr.
exec 1>&2

# Cross platform projects tend to avoid non-ASCII filenames; prevent
# them from being added to the repository. We exploit the fact that the
# printable range starts at the space character and ends with tilde.
if [ "$allownonascii" != "true" ] &&
	# Note that the use of brackets around a tr range is ok here, (it's
	# even required, for portability to Solaris 10's /usr/bin/tr), since
	# the square bracket bytes happen to fall in the designated range.
	test $(git diff-index --cached --name-only --diff-filter=A -z $against |
	  LC_ALL=C tr -d '[ -~]\0' | wc -c) != 0
then
	cat <<\EOF
Error: Attempt to add a non-ASCII file name.

This can cause problems if you want to work with people on other platforms.

To be portable it is advisable to rename the file.

If you know what you are doing you can disable this check using:

  git config hooks.allownonascii true
EOF
	exit 1
fi

# If there are whitespace errors, print the offending file names and fail.
exec git diff-index --check --cached $against --

FILE: .git/hooks/pre-push.sample
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/.git/hooks/pre-push.sample
====================================================================================================
#!/bin/sh

# An example hook script to verify what is about to be pushed.  Called by "git
# push" after it has checked the remote status, but before anything has been
# pushed.  If this script exits with a non-zero status nothing will be pushed.
#
# This hook is called with the following parameters:
#
# $1 -- Name of the remote to which the push is being done
# $2 -- URL to which the push is being done
#
# If pushing without using a named remote those arguments will be equal.
#
# Information about the commits which are being pushed is supplied as lines to
# the standard input in the form:
#
#   <local ref> <local oid> <remote ref> <remote oid>
#
# This sample shows how to prevent push of commits where the log message starts
# with "WIP" (work in progress).

remote="$1"
url="$2"

zero=$(git hash-object --stdin </dev/null | tr '[0-9a-f]' '0')

while read local_ref local_oid remote_ref remote_oid
do
	if test "$local_oid" = "$zero"
	then
		# Handle delete
		:
	else
		if test "$remote_oid" = "$zero"
		then
			# New branch, examine all commits
			range="$local_oid"
		else
			# Update to existing branch, examine new commits
			range="$remote_oid..$local_oid"
		fi

		# Check for WIP commit
		commit=$(git rev-list -n 1 --grep '^WIP' "$range")
		if test -n "$commit"
		then
			echo >&2 "Found WIP commit in $local_ref, not pushing"
			exit 1
		fi
	fi
done

exit 0

FILE: .git/hooks/pre-rebase.sample
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/.git/hooks/pre-rebase.sample
====================================================================================================
#!/bin/sh
#
# Copyright (c) 2006, 2008 Junio C Hamano
#
# The "pre-rebase" hook is run just before "git rebase" starts doing
# its job, and can prevent the command from running by exiting with
# non-zero status.
#
# The hook is called with the following parameters:
#
# $1 -- the upstream the series was forked from.
# $2 -- the branch being rebased (or empty when rebasing the current branch).
#
# This sample shows how to prevent topic branches that are already
# merged to 'next' branch from getting rebased, because allowing it
# would result in rebasing already published history.

publish=next
basebranch="$1"
if test "$#" = 2
then
	topic="refs/heads/$2"
else
	topic=`git symbolic-ref HEAD` ||
	exit 0 ;# we do not interrupt rebasing detached HEAD
fi

case "$topic" in
refs/heads/??/*)
	;;
*)
	exit 0 ;# we do not interrupt others.
	;;
esac

# Now we are dealing with a topic branch being rebased
# on top of master.  Is it OK to rebase it?

# Does the topic really exist?
git show-ref -q "$topic" || {
	echo >&2 "No such branch $topic"
	exit 1
}

# Is topic fully merged to master?
not_in_master=`git rev-list --pretty=oneline ^master "$topic"`
if test -z "$not_in_master"
then
	echo >&2 "$topic is fully merged to master; better remove it."
	exit 1 ;# we could allow it, but there is no point.
fi

# Is topic ever merged to next?  If so you should not be rebasing it.
only_next_1=`git rev-list ^master "^$topic" ${publish} | sort`
only_next_2=`git rev-list ^master           ${publish} | sort`
if test "$only_next_1" = "$only_next_2"
then
	not_in_topic=`git rev-list "^$topic" master`
	if test -z "$not_in_topic"
	then
		echo >&2 "$topic is already up to date with master"
		exit 1 ;# we could allow it, but there is no point.
	else
		exit 0
	fi
else
	not_in_next=`git rev-list --pretty=oneline ^${publish} "$topic"`
	/usr/bin/perl -e '
		my $topic = $ARGV[0];
		my $msg = "* $topic has commits already merged to public branch:\n";
		my (%not_in_next) = map {
			/^([0-9a-f]+) /;
			($1 => 1);
		} split(/\n/, $ARGV[1]);
		for my $elem (map {
				/^([0-9a-f]+) (.*)$/;
				[$1 => $2];
			} split(/\n/, $ARGV[2])) {
			if (!exists $not_in_next{$elem->[0]}) {
				if ($msg) {
					print STDERR $msg;
					undef $msg;
				}
				print STDERR " $elem->[1]\n";
			}
		}
	' "$topic" "$not_in_next" "$not_in_master"
	exit 1
fi

<<\DOC_END

This sample hook safeguards topic branches that have been
published from being rewound.

The workflow assumed here is:

 * Once a topic branch forks from "master", "master" is never
   merged into it again (either directly or indirectly).

 * Once a topic branch is fully cooked and merged into "master",
   it is deleted.  If you need to build on top of it to correct
   earlier mistakes, a new topic branch is created by forking at
   the tip of the "master".  This is not strictly necessary, but
   it makes it easier to keep your history simple.

 * Whenever you need to test or publish your changes to topic
   branches, merge them into "next" branch.

The script, being an example, hardcodes the publish branch name
to be "next", but it is trivial to make it configurable via
$GIT_DIR/config mechanism.

With this workflow, you would want to know:

(1) ... if a topic branch has ever been merged to "next".  Young
    topic branches can have stupid mistakes you would rather
    clean up before publishing, and things that have not been
    merged into other branches can be easily rebased without
    affecting other people.  But once it is published, you would
    not want to rewind it.

(2) ... if a topic branch has been fully merged to "master".
    Then you can delete it.  More importantly, you should not
    build on top of it -- other people may already want to
    change things related to the topic as patches against your
    "master", so if you need further changes, it is better to
    fork the topic (perhaps with the same name) afresh from the
    tip of "master".

Let's look at this example:

		   o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o "next"
		  /       /           /           /
		 /   a---a---b A     /           /
		/   /               /           /
	       /   /   c---c---c---c B         /
	      /   /   /             \         /
	     /   /   /   b---b C     \       /
	    /   /   /   /             \     /
    ---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o "master"


A, B and C are topic branches.

 * A has one fix since it was merged up to "next".

 * B has finished.  It has been fully merged up to "master" and "next",
   and is ready to be deleted.

 * C has not merged to "next" at all.

We would want to allow C to be rebased, refuse A, and encourage
B to be deleted.

To compute (1):

	git rev-list ^master ^topic next
	git rev-list ^master        next

	if these match, topic has not merged in next at all.

To compute (2):

	git rev-list master..topic

	if this is empty, it is fully merged to "master".

DOC_END

FILE: .git/hooks/pre-receive.sample
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/.git/hooks/pre-receive.sample
====================================================================================================
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to make use of push options.
# The example simply echoes all push options that start with 'echoback='
# and rejects all pushes when the "reject" push option is used.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "pre-receive".

if test -n "$GIT_PUSH_OPTION_COUNT"
then
	i=0
	while test "$i" -lt "$GIT_PUSH_OPTION_COUNT"
	do
		eval "value=\$GIT_PUSH_OPTION_$i"
		case "$value" in
		echoback=*)
			echo "echo from the pre-receive-hook: ${value#*=}" >&2
			;;
		reject)
			exit 1
		esac
		i=$((i + 1))
	done
fi

FILE: .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg.sample
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/.git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg.sample
====================================================================================================
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to prepare the commit log message.
# Called by "git commit" with the name of the file that has the
# commit message, followed by the description of the commit
# message's source.  The hook's purpose is to edit the commit
# message file.  If the hook fails with a non-zero status,
# the commit is aborted.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "prepare-commit-msg".

# This hook includes three examples. The first one removes the
# "# Please enter the commit message..." help message.
#
# The second includes the output of "git diff --name-status -r"
# into the message, just before the "git status" output.  It is
# commented because it doesn't cope with --amend or with squashed
# commits.
#
# The third example adds a Signed-off-by line to the message, that can
# still be edited.  This is rarely a good idea.

COMMIT_SOURCE=$2
SHA1=$3

FILE: .git/hooks/push-to-checkout.sample
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/.git/hooks/push-to-checkout.sample
====================================================================================================
#!/bin/sh

# An example hook script to update a checked-out tree on a git push.
#
# This hook is invoked by git-receive-pack(1) when it reacts to git
# push and updates reference(s) in its repository, and when the push
# tries to update the branch that is currently checked out and the
# receive.denyCurrentBranch configuration variable is set to
# updateInstead.
#
# By default, such a push is refused if the working tree and the index
# of the remote repository has any difference from the currently
# checked out commit; when both the working tree and the index match
# the current commit, they are updated to match the newly pushed tip
# of the branch. This hook is to be used to override the default
# behaviour; however the code below reimplements the default behaviour
# as a starting point for convenient modification.
#
# The hook receives the commit with which the tip of the current
# branch is going to be updated:
commit=$1

# It can exit with a non-zero status to refuse the push (when it does
# so, it must not modify the index or the working tree).
die () {
	echo >&2 "$*"
	exit 1
}

# Or it can make any necessary changes to the working tree and to the
# index to bring them to the desired state when the tip of the current
# branch is updated to the new commit, and exit with a zero status.
#
# For example, the hook can simply run git read-tree -u -m HEAD "$1"
# in order to emulate git fetch that is run in the reverse direction
# with git push, as the two-tree form of git read-tree -u -m is
# essentially the same as git switch or git checkout that switches
# branches while keeping the local changes in the working tree that do
# not interfere with the difference between the branches.

# The below is a more-or-less exact translation to shell of the C code
# for the default behaviour for git's push-to-checkout hook defined in
# the push_to_deploy() function in builtin/receive-pack.c.
#
# Note that the hook will be executed from the repository directory,
# not from the working tree, so if you want to perform operations on
# the working tree, you will have to adapt your code accordingly, e.g.
# by adding "cd .." or using relative paths.

if ! git update-index -q --ignore-submodules --refresh
then
	die "Up-to-date check failed"
fi

if ! git diff-files --quiet --ignore-submodules --
then
	die "Working directory has unstaged changes"
fi

# This is a rough translation of:
#
#   head_has_history() ? "HEAD" : EMPTY_TREE_SHA1_HEX
if git cat-file -e HEAD 2>/dev/null
then
	head=HEAD
else
	head=$(git hash-object -t tree --stdin </dev/null)
fi

if ! git diff-index --quiet --cached --ignore-submodules $head --
then
	die "Working directory has staged changes"
fi

if ! git read-tree -u -m "$commit"
then
	die "Could not update working tree to new HEAD"
fi

#!/bin/sh

# An example hook script to validate a patch (and/or patch series) before
# sending it via email.
#
# The hook should exit with non-zero status after issuing an appropriate
# message if it wants to prevent the email(s) from being sent.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "sendemail-validate".
#
# By default, it will only check that the patch(es) can be applied on top of
# the default upstream branch without conflicts in a secondary worktree. After
# validation (successful or not) of the last patch of a series, the worktree
# will be deleted.
#
# The following config variables can be set to change the default remote and
# remote ref that are used to apply the patches against:
#
#   sendemail.validateRemote (default: origin)
#   sendemail.validateRemoteRef (default: HEAD)
#
# Replace the TODO placeholders with appropriate checks according to your
# needs.

validate_cover_letter () {
	file="$1"
	# TODO: Replace with appropriate checks (e.g. spell checking).
	true
}

validate_patch () {
	file="$1"
	# Ensure that the patch applies without conflicts.
	git am -3 "$file" || return
	# TODO: Replace with appropriate checks for this patch
	# (e.g. checkpatch.pl).
	true
}

validate_series () {
	# TODO: Replace with appropriate checks for the whole series
	# (e.g. quick build, coding style checks, etc.).
	true
}

# main -------------------------------------------------------------------------

if test "$GIT_SENDEMAIL_FILE_COUNTER" = 1
then
	remote=$(git config --default origin --get sendemail.validateRemote) &&
	ref=$(git config --default HEAD --get sendemail.validateRemoteRef) &&
	worktree=$(mktemp --tmpdir -d sendemail-validate.XXXXXXX) &&
	git worktree add -fd --checkout "$worktree" "refs/remotes/$remote/$ref" &&
	git config --replace-all sendemail.validateWorktree "$worktree"
else
	worktree=$(git config --get sendemail.validateWorktree)
fi || {
	echo "sendemail-validate: error: failed to prepare worktree" >&2
	exit 1
}

unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE
cd "$worktree" &&

if grep -q "^diff --git " "$1"
then
	validate_patch "$1"
else
	validate_cover_letter "$1"
fi &&

if test "$GIT_SENDEMAIL_FILE_COUNTER" = "$GIT_SENDEMAIL_FILE_TOTAL"
then
	git config --unset-all sendemail.validateWorktree &&
	trap 'git worktree remove -ff "$worktree"' EXIT &&
	validate_series
fi

FILE: .git/hooks/update.sample
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/.git/hooks/update.sample
====================================================================================================
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to block unannotated tags from entering.
# Called by "git receive-pack" with arguments: refname sha1-old sha1-new
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "update".
#
# Config
# ------
# hooks.allowunannotated
#   This boolean sets whether unannotated tags will be allowed into the
#   repository.  By default they won't be.
# hooks.allowdeletetag
#   This boolean sets whether deleting tags will be allowed in the
#   repository.  By default they won't be.
# hooks.allowmodifytag
#   This boolean sets whether a tag may be modified after creation. By default
#   it won't be.
# hooks.allowdeletebranch
#   This boolean sets whether deleting branches will be allowed in the
#   repository.  By default they won't be.
# hooks.denycreatebranch
#   This boolean sets whether remotely creating branches will be denied
#   in the repository.  By default this is allowed.
#

# --- Command line
refname="$1"
oldrev="$2"
newrev="$3"

# --- Safety check
if [ -z "$GIT_DIR" ]; then
	echo "Don't run this script from the command line." >&2
	echo " (if you want, you could supply GIT_DIR then run" >&2
	echo "  $0 <ref> <oldrev> <newrev>)" >&2
	exit 1
fi

if [ -z "$refname" -o -z "$oldrev" -o -z "$newrev" ]; then
	echo "usage: $0 <ref> <oldrev> <newrev>" >&2
	exit 1
fi

# --- Config
allowunannotated=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allowunannotated)
allowdeletebranch=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allowdeletebranch)
denycreatebranch=$(git config --type=bool hooks.denycreatebranch)
allowdeletetag=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allowdeletetag)
allowmodifytag=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allowmodifytag)

# check for no description
projectdesc=$(sed -e '1q' "$GIT_DIR/description")
case "$projectdesc" in
"Unnamed repository"* | "")
	echo "*** Project description file hasn't been set" >&2
	exit 1
	;;
esac

# --- Check types
# if $newrev is 0000...0000, it's a commit to delete a ref.
zero=$(git hash-object --stdin </dev/null | tr '[0-9a-f]' '0')
if [ "$newrev" = "$zero" ]; then
	newrev_type=delete
else
	newrev_type=$(git cat-file -t $newrev)
fi

case "$refname","$newrev_type" in
	refs/tags/*,commit)
		# un-annotated tag
		short_refname=${refname##refs/tags/}
		if [ "$allowunannotated" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** The un-annotated tag, $short_refname, is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			echo "*** Use 'git tag [ -a | -s ]' for tags you want to propagate." >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/tags/*,delete)
		# delete tag
		if [ "$allowdeletetag" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Deleting a tag is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/tags/*,tag)
		# annotated tag
		if [ "$allowmodifytag" != "true" ] && git rev-parse $refname > /dev/null 2>&1
		then
			echo "*** Tag '$refname' already exists." >&2
			echo "*** Modifying a tag is not allowed in this repository." >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/heads/*,commit)
		# branch
		if [ "$oldrev" = "$zero" -a "$denycreatebranch" = "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Creating a branch is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/heads/*,delete)
		# delete branch
		if [ "$allowdeletebranch" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Deleting a branch is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/remotes/*,commit)
		# tracking branch
		;;
	refs/remotes/*,delete)
		# delete tracking branch
		if [ "$allowdeletebranch" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Deleting a tracking branch is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	*)
		# Anything else (is there anything else?)
		echo "*** Update hook: unknown type of update to ref $refname of type $newrev_type" >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac

# --- Finished
exit 0

====================================================================================================
FILE: Dockerfile
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/Dockerfile
====================================================================================================
# ============================================
# STAGE 1: Build
# ============================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /app

COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install

COPY . .

ENV NODE_ENV=production

RUN npm run build

# ============================================
# STAGE 2: Serve dengan nginx
# ============================================
FROM nginx:alpine

COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

EXPOSE 80

CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]

# Install tools dasar

## Getting Started

A React Framework for building internal tools, admin panels, dashboards & B2B apps with unmatched flexibility ✨

Refine's hooks and components simplifies the development process and eliminates the repetitive tasks by providing industry-standard solutions for crucial aspects of a project, including authentication, access control, routing, networking, state management, and i18n.

## Available Scripts

### Running the development server.

```bash
    npm run dev
```

### Building for production.

```bash
    npm run build
```

### Running the production server.

```bash
    npm run start
```

====================================================================================================
FILE: cjs/generate_spb.cjs
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/cjs/generate_spb.cjs
====================================================================================================
const XLSX = require("xlsx");
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const FILENAME = "Monitoring SPB Atiara Ubud Bali Update 13102026 (1).xlsx";

try {
  if (!fs.existsSync(FILENAME)) {
    console.error(`❌ File Excel "${FILENAME}" tidak ditemukan.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log(`⏳ Membaca file: ${FILENAME}...`);
  const wb = XLSX.readFile(FILENAME);
  const ws = wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]];

  const rawData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { header: 1, defval: null });

  const poData = [];
  const spbData = [];
  let poIdCounter = 1;
  let spbIdCounter = 1;
  let lastSpbNo = null;
  let lastPoNo = null;
  let lastSpbTgl = null;

  function formatExcelDate(dateVal) {
    if (!dateVal) return null;
    if (typeof dateVal === 'number') {
      const date = new Date(Math.round((dateVal - 25569) * 86400 * 1000));
      return date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
    }
    return String(dateVal).trim();
  }

  for (let i = 4; i < rawData.length; i++) {
    const row = rawData[i];
    if (!row || row.length < 5) continue;

    // KARENA KOLOM A KOSONG DI EXCEL, SEMUA INDEX DIGESER -1 AGAR COCOK
    const spbNoRaw = row[0];
    const spbTglRaw = row[1];
    const noBarangRaw = row[2];
    const namaBarang = row[3];
    const ukuranRaw = row[4];
    const qtyMinta = parseInt(row[5]) || 0;
    const satuanRaw = row[6];
    const poNoRaw = row[7];
    const poTglRaw = row[8];
    const supplierRaw = row[9];
    const statusVal = row[10] ? String(row[10]).trim() : "BELUM DATANG";
    const merkRaw = row[11];
    const spesifikasiRaw = row[12];
    const lokasiRaw = row[13];
    const rencanaRaw = row[14];
    const tglDatangRaw = row[16];
    const keteranganRaw = row[21];

    if (!namaBarang) continue; 

    if (spbNoRaw) lastSpbNo = String(spbNoRaw).trim();
    if (poNoRaw) lastPoNo = String(poNoRaw).trim();
    if (spbTglRaw) lastSpbTgl = formatExcelDate(spbTglRaw);

    const spbNo = lastSpbNo;
    const poNo = lastPoNo;
    const spbTgl = lastSpbTgl;
    const poTgl = formatExcelDate(poTglRaw); 
    const tglDatang = formatExcelDate(tglDatangRaw);

    let currentPoId = null;
    if (poNo && poNo !== 'null' && poNo !== '-' && poNo !== 'false') {
      currentPoId = poIdCounter;
      poData.push({
        id: currentPoId,
        no_po: poNo,
        no_spb: spbNo || null,
        no_barang_di_po: noBarangRaw ? String(noBarangRaw).trim() : null,
        tanggal_po: poTgl,
        supplier: supplierRaw ? String(supplierRaw).trim() : null,
        kode_barang: null,
        nama_barang: String(namaBarang).trim(),
        merk: merkRaw ? String(merkRaw).trim() : null,
        spesifikasi_barang: spesifikasiRaw ? String(spesifikasiRaw).trim() : null,
        keterangan: keteranganRaw ? String(keteranganRaw).trim() : null
      });
      poIdCounter++;
    }

    spbData.push({
      id: spbIdCounter,
      no_spb: spbNo || "UNKNOWN",
      tanggal_pembuatan_spb: spbTgl,
      kode_barang: null,
      nama_barang: String(namaBarang).trim(),
      jumlah_permintaan: qtyMinta,
      satuan: satuanRaw ? String(satuanRaw).trim() : null,
      merk: merkRaw ? String(merkRaw).trim() : null,
      spesifikasi_teknis: spesifikasiRaw ? String(spesifikasiRaw).trim() : null,
      lokasi_pemasangan: lokasiRaw ? String(lokasiRaw).trim() : null,
      rencana_pemasangan: rencanaRaw ? String(rencanaRaw).trim() : null,
      keterangan: keteranganRaw ? String(keteranganRaw).trim() : null,
      po_id: currentPoId,
      no_po: currentPoId ? poNo : null,
      tanggal_po: currentPoId ? poTgl : null,
      status: statusVal === "false" ? "BELUM DATANG" : statusVal,
      tanggal_datang: tglDatang
    });
    
    spbIdCounter++;
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "data_po_final.json"), JSON.stringify(poData, null, 2), "utf-8");
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "data_spb_final.json"), JSON.stringify(spbData, null, 2), "utf-8");

  console.log(`✅ BERHASIL MEMPERBAIKI DATA JSON!`);
  console.log(`Menghasilkan ${poData.length} data PO ke 'data_po_final.json'`);
  console.log(`Menghasilkan ${spbData.length} data SPB ke 'data_spb_final.json'`);

} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌ Terjadi kesalahan:", error.message);
}

FILE: cjs/products.cjs
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/cjs/products.cjs

require('dotenv').config();
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

// Mengambil kredensial Supabase dari file .env
const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL; 
const SUPABASE_KEY = process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_KEY;

if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SUPABASE_KEY) {
  console.error("❌ ERROR: VITE_SUPABASE_URL atau VITE_SUPABASE_KEY tidak ditemukan di file .env!");
  process.exit(1);
}

const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);

async function fetchAllBarang() {
  try {
    console.log("⏳ Mengambil semua data dari tabel 'barang' di Supabase...");
    
    // Mengambil semua baris data dan mengurutkannya berdasarkan ID
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('barang')
      .select('*')
      .order('id', { ascending: true });

    if (error) {
      throw error;
    }

    // Menentukan path dan nama file JSON output
    const outputPath = path.join(__dirname, 'barang_all.json');
    
    // Menulis data ke file JSON dengan format yang rapi (indentasi 2 spasi)
    fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), 'utf-8');

    console.log(`✅ BERHASIL! Berhasil menarik ${data.length} baris data barang.`);
    console.log(`💾 Seluruh data telah disimpan ke dalam file 'barang_all.json'.`);
    
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("❌ Terjadi kesalahan saat menarik data:", err.message);
  }
}

fetchAllBarang();

require('dotenv').config();
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

// 1. Inisialisasi Supabase Client
const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL; 
const SUPABASE_KEY = process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_KEY; 

if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SUPABASE_KEY) {
  console.error("❌ ERROR: VITE_SUPABASE_URL atau VITE_SUPABASE_KEY tidak ditemukan di .env!");
  process.exit(1);
}

const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);

async function resetAndInsertData() {
  try {
    // 2. Tentukan nama file JSON yang akan dibaca
    const poPath = path.join(__dirname, 'data_po_final.json');
    const spbPath = path.join(__dirname, 'data_spb_final.json');

    if (!fs.existsSync(poPath) || !fs.existsSync(spbPath)) {
      console.error(`❌ ERROR: File JSON tidak ditemukan. Pastikan 'data_po_3.json' dan 'data_spb_3.json' ada di folder ini.`);
      return;
    }

    const poData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(poPath, 'utf-8'));
    const spbData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(spbPath, 'utf-8'));

    console.log("⚠️ PERINGATAN: Memulai proses penghapusan data lama...");

    // 3. MENGHAPUS SEMUA DATA LAMA (DELETE FROM TABLE)
    // Hapus data SPB terlebih dahulu karena bergantung (foreign key) pada PO
    console.log("🧹 Menghapus semua data dari tabel 'spb'...");
    const { error: deleteSpbError } = await supabase
      .from('spb')
      .delete()
      .neq('id', 0); // Menghapus baris dimana ID != 0 (menghapus semua)

    if (deleteSpbError) throw new Error(`Gagal hapus data SPB: ${deleteSpbError.message}`);

    console.log("🧹 Menghapus semua data dari tabel 'po'...");
    const { error: deletePoError } = await supabase
      .from('po')
      .delete()
      .neq('id', 0);

    if (deletePoError) throw new Error(`Gagal hapus data PO: ${deletePoError.message}`);

    console.log("✅ Data lama berhasil dibersihkan!");
    console.log("⏳ Memulai proses penyisipan data baru...");

    // 4. INSERT DATA PO BARU
    if (poData.length > 0) {
      console.log(`📥 Menyisipkan ${poData.length} baris data ke tabel 'po'...`);
      const { error: insertPoError } = await supabase
        .from('po')
        .insert(poData);
      
      if (insertPoError) throw new Error(`Gagal insert PO: ${insertPoError.message}`);
      console.log("✅ Data PO berhasil dimasukkan.");
    }

    // 5. INSERT DATA SPB BARU
    if (spbData.length > 0) {
      console.log(`📥 Menyisipkan ${spbData.length} baris data ke tabel 'spb'...`);
      const { error: insertSpbError } = await supabase
        .from('spb')
        .insert(spbData);
      
      if (insertSpbError) throw new Error(`Gagal insert SPB: ${insertSpbError.message}`);
      console.log("✅ Data SPB berhasil dimasukkan.");
    }

    console.log("🎉 SELURUH PROSES SELESAI DENGAN SUKSES!");

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("\n❌ TERJADI KESALAHAN:");
    console.error(error.message);
  }
}

resetAndInsertData();

    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css text/javascript application/javascript application/json image/svg+xml;

    # Cache statis 1 tahun
    location ~* \.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg|woff|woff2|ttf|eot)$ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
        access_log off;
    }

    # SPA fallback — WAJIB
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache";
    }

    # Health check
    location /health {
        access_log off;
        return 200 "ok\n";
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
    }
}

FILE: project.cjs
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/project.cjs

const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");

const ROOT_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname);
const OUTPUT_FILE = path.join(ROOT_DIR, "admin-stok-full.txt");

const EXCLUDED_DIRS = new Set([
  "node_modules",
]);

const EXCLUDED_FILES = new Set([
  ".env",
  ".env.local",
]);

const chunks = [];
let copied = 0;
let skipped = 0;

function walk(dir) {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, {
    withFileTypes: true,
  });

  for (const entry of entries) {
    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      if (EXCLUDED_DIRS.has(entry.name)) {
        console.log(`SKIP folder: ${fullPath}`);
        continue;
      }

      walk(fullPath);
      continue;
    }

    if (!entry.isFile()) continue;

    // Abaikan file environment yang ditentukan
    if (EXCLUDED_FILES.has(entry.name)) {
      console.log(`SKIP file: ${path.relative(ROOT_DIR, fullPath)}`);
      skipped++;
      continue;
    }

    // Jangan masukkan file output ke dalam dirinya sendiri
    if (fullPath === OUTPUT_FILE) continue;

    // Baca file sebagai buffer agar file biner bisa dikenali
    const buffer = fs.readFileSync(fullPath);

    if (buffer.includes(0)) {
      console.log(`SKIP binary: ${path.relative(ROOT_DIR, fullPath)}`);
      skipped++;
      continue;
    }

    const relativePath = path.relative(ROOT_DIR, fullPath);
    const content = buffer.toString("utf8");

    chunks.push(
      [
        "",
        "=".repeat(100),
        `FILE: ${relativePath}`,
        `ABSOLUTE PATH: ${fullPath}`,
        "=".repeat(100),
        content,
        "",
      ].join("\n")
    );

    copied++;
    console.log(`COPY: ${relativePath}`);
  }
}

try {
  walk(ROOT_DIR);

  fs.writeFileSync(
    OUTPUT_FILE,
    chunks.join("\n"),
    "utf8"
  );

  console.log("\n========================================");
  console.log("SELESAI");
  console.log(`File disalin : ${copied}`);
  console.log(`File dilewati: ${skipped}`);
  console.log(`Hasil        : ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);
  console.log("========================================");
} catch (error) {
  console.error("Gagal:", error.message);
  process.exitCode = 1;
}

const mockDataProvider = {
  getList: async () => ({ data: [], total: 0 }),
  getOne: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  create: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  update: async () => ({ data: {} }),

  getApiUrl: () => "",
  custom: async () => ({ data: {} }),
} as never;

function App() {

    ? mockDataProvider
    : dataProvider(supabaseClient);

  const liveProviderConfig = USE_MOCK
    ? undefined
    : liveProvider(supabaseClient);

  return (

      >

          <RefineKbarProvider>

FILE: src/authProvider.ts
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/src/authProvider.ts

import type {
  AuthProvider,
  AuthActionResponse,
  CheckResponse,
} from "@refinedev/core";
import { supabaseClient } from "./utility/supabaseClient";
import { USE_MOCK } from "./utility/config";

const MOCK_USER = {
  email: "admin@admin.com",
  password: "admin123",
  name: "Administrator",
};

const STORAGE_KEY = "mock-auth-user";

const getMockUser = () => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const authProvider: AuthProvider = {
  login: async ({ email, password }): Promise<AuthActionResponse> => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
      if (email === MOCK_USER.email && password === MOCK_USER.password) {
        localStorage.setItem(
          STORAGE_KEY,
          JSON.stringify({ email, name: MOCK_USER.name, role: "admin" }),
        );
        return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
      }
      return {
        success: false,
        error: {
          name: "LoginError",
          message: "Email atau password salah",
        },
      };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email,
      password,
    });

    if (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { name: "LoginError", message: error.message },
      };
    }
    if (!data?.user) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { name: "LoginError", message: "User tidak ditemukan" },
      };
    }
    return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
  },

  logout: async (): Promise<AuthActionResponse> => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
    }
    await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();
    return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
  },

  // ✅ Selalu izinkan akses agar User (Public) bisa melihat stok tanpa harus login
  check: async (): Promise<CheckResponse> => {
    return { authenticated: true };
  },

  getIdentity: async () => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      const user = getMockUser();
      if (user) {
        return {
          id: "admin-1",
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
          role: "admin",
        };
      }
      return {
        id: "public-user",
        name: "User (Public)",
        email: "",
        role: "user",
      };
    }

    const { data } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();
    if (data?.user) {
      return {
        id: data.user.id,
        name: data.user.email?.split("@")[0] ?? "Admin",
        email: data.user.email,
        role: "admin",
      };
    }

    return {
      id: "public-user",
      name: "User (Public)",
      email: "",
      role: "user",
    };
  },

  getPermissions: async () => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      const user = getMockUser();
      return user ? ["admin"] : ["user"];
    }
    const { data } = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
    return data.session ? ["admin"] : ["user"];
  },

  onError: async (error) => {
    return { error };
  },
};

FILE: src/components/common/GlobalSearch.tsx
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/src/components/common/GlobalSearch.tsx
====================================================================================================
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Input, Modal, Spin, Empty, Tag, Typography } from "antd";
import { SearchOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import { useKeyboardShortcut } from "../../hooks/useKeyboardShortcut";
import { useProductSearch } from "../../hooks/useProductSearch";
import type { Product } from "../../types";

const { Text } = Typography;

export const GlobalSearch = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const { products, isLoading } = useProductSearch(keyword);

  // Reset state saat modal terbuka
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setKeyword("");
      setActiveIndex(0);
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
    }
  }, [open]);

  // Clamp active index saat hasil berubah
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeIndex >= products.length) setActiveIndex(0);
  }, [products.length, activeIndex]);

  const handleSelect = useCallback(
    (product: Product) => {
      setOpen(false);
      navigate(`/stock-entries/create?productId=${product.id}`);
    },
    [navigate],
  );

  // ⌨️ Space → buka palette (kecuali sedang mengetik di input)
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: " ",
    ignoreInputs: true,
    enabled: !open,
    handler: () => setOpen(true),
  });

  // ⌨️ Ctrl+K → buka palette juga (opsional, umum dipakai)
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: "k",
    ctrlKey: true,
    enabled: !open,
    handler: () => setOpen(true),
  });

  const handleKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((i) => Math.min(i + 1, products.length - 1));
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (event.key === "Enter") {
      event.preventDefault();
      const selected = products[activeIndex];
      if (selected) handleSelect(selected);
    } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
      footer={null}
      closable={false}
      width={560}
      destroyOnClose
      styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
      style={{ top: 80 }}
    >
      <div style={{ padding: 12, borderBottom: "1px solid #f0f0f0" }}>
        <Input
          ref={inputRef as never}
          size="large"
          prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
          placeholder="Cari produk berdasarkan nama atau kode..."
          value={keyword}
          onChange={(e) => setKeyword(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          variant="borderless"
          autoFocus
        />
      </div>

      <div style={{ maxHeight: 360, overflowY: "auto", padding: 8 }}>
        {isLoading && (
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 24 }}>
            <Spin />
          </div>
        )}

        {!isLoading && products.length === 0 && (
          <Empty
            description="Produk tidak ditemukan"
            image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
            style={{ padding: 24 }}
          />
        )}

        {!isLoading &&
          products.map((product, index) => (
            <div
              key={product.id}
              onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
              onClick={() => handleSelect(product)}
              style={{
                padding: "10px 12px",
                borderRadius: 8,
                cursor: "pointer",
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                gap: 12,
                background:
                  index === activeIndex ? "#e6f4ff" : "transparent",
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: 14 }}>
                  {product.name}
                </div>
                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  {product.code} · Stok: {product.stock} {product.unit}
                </Text>
              </div>
              <Tag color="blue" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
                Input
              </Tag>
            </div>
          ))}
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          padding: "8px 16px",
          borderTop: "1px solid #f0f0f0",
          display: "flex",
          gap: 16,
          fontSize: 12,
          color: "#8c8c8c",
        }}
      >
        <span>↑↓ navigasi</span>
        <span>↵ pilih</span>
        <span>esc tutup</span>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
};

export const StockExitList = ({ exits, loading }: Props) => {

                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#666", marginBottom: 6 }}>
                  <SendOutlined /> {exit.destination}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Items */}

                  <div
                    key={idx}

                      )}

                    >
                      {formatNumber(item.quantity)} {item.unit}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </Space>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
};

      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (!items.length) {
    return (
      <Card
        title="📈 Barang Masuk 30 Hari Terakhir"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
      >
        <Empty description="Belum ada transaksi 30 hari terakhir" />
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const data = items.map((i) => ({
    date: formatDate(i.date),
    total: i.total,
  }));

  return (
    <Card
      title="📈 Barang Masuk 30 Hari Terakhir"
      style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
    >
      <Line
        data={data}
        xField="date"
        yField="total"
        height={300}
        smooth
        point={{ size: 4, shape: "circle" }}
        color="#1677ff"
        tooltip={{ showMarkers: false }}
        xAxis={{ label: { autoRotate: false, autoHide: true } }}
        yAxis={{
          label: {
            formatter: (v: string) => Number(v).toLocaleString("id-ID"),
          },
        }}
      />
    </Card>
  );
};

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  AutoComplete,
  Button,
  Card,
  Input,
  Modal,
  Space,
  Steps,
  Tag,
  Typography,
} from "antd";
import { SearchOutlined, UserOutlined, EnvironmentOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import type { Person, Workplace } from "../../types/entry";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  step: "person" | "workplace";
  title: string;
  placeholder: string;
  options: readonly (Person | Workplace)[];
  onSelect: (value: Person | Workplace) => void;
  onBack?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const STEP_INDEX: Record<"person" | "workplace", number> = {
  person: 0,
  workplace: 1,
};

export const SetupWizard = ({
  open,
  step,
  title,
  placeholder,
  options,
  onSelect,
  onBack,
  onClose,
}: Props) => {
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setKeyword("");
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [open, step]);

  const filtered = options.filter((o) =>
    o.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword.trim().toLowerCase()),
  );

  const handleEnter = () => {
    if (filtered.length > 0) {
      onSelect(filtered[0]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={onClose}
      footer={null}
      closable
      maskClosable
      keyboard
      width={520}
      styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
      style={{ top: 80 }}
    >
      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 16 }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 24 } }}
      >
        <Steps
          current={STEP_INDEX[step]}
          size="small"
          items={[
            { title: "Nama Pekerja", icon: <UserOutlined /> },
            { title: "Lokasi Pekerjaan", icon: <EnvironmentOutlined /> },
          ]}
          style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}
        />

        <Title level={4} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
          {title}
        </Title>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <AutoComplete
            value={keyword}
            onChange={setKeyword}
            options={filtered.map((o) => ({
              value: o.name,
              label: o.name,
              data: o,
            }))}
            onSelect={(_, option) => {
              const data = (option as { data: Person | Workplace }).data;
              onSelect(data);
            }}
            style={{ width: "100%" }}
            placeholder={placeholder}
          >
            <Input
              ref={inputRef as never}
              size="large"
              prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter") {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  handleEnter();
                } else if (e.key === "Escape" && onBack) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  onBack();
                }
              }}
              autoFocus
            />
          </AutoComplete>
        </div>

        {/* Tombol Pilihan Cepat (Sangat memudahkan di Mobile & Desktop) */}
        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <Space size={[8, 8]} wrap>
            {filtered.map((item) => (
              <Button
                key={item.id}
                size="middle"
                style={{ borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 500 }}
                onClick={() => onSelect(item)}
              >
                {item.name}
              </Button>
            ))}
          </Space>
        </div>

        <Space style={{ marginTop: 20 }} size="small" wrap>
          <Tag>Enter</Tag>
          <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
            pilih item pertama
          </Text>
          {onBack && (
            <>
              <Tag style={{ cursor: "pointer" }} onClick={onBack}>
                Esc / Kembali
              </Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                kembali ke pilih nama
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
        </Space>
      </Card>
    </Modal>
  );
};

import { useState } from "react";

const { Text } = Typography;

interface StockProps extends BaseProps {

  type: "outbound";
  dataSource: StockExit[];
}

type InventoryTableProps = StockProps | OutboundProps;

export const InventoryTable = (props: InventoryTableProps) => {
  const { type, loading } = props;
  const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState("");

  const stockColumns = [
    { 
      dataIndex: "name", 
      title: "Nama Item",
      render: (v: string) => <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{v}</Text>
    },
    {
      dataIndex: "size",
      title: "Ukuran",
      width: 200,
      render: (v: string | null) => v ? <Text type="secondary">{v}</Text> : "-",
    },
    {
      dataIndex: "stock",
      title: "Stok Tersedia",
      width: 160,
      align: "right" as const,
      defaultSortOrder: "descend" as const,
      sorter: (a: Product, b: Product) => a.stock - b.stock,
      render: (v: number, r: Product) => (
        <Tag color={v > 0 ? "blue" : "red"} style={{ fontSize: 13, padding: "2px 8px" }}>
          {formatNumber(v)} {r.unit}
        </Tag>
      ),
    },
  ];

  const outboundColumns = [
    {
      title: "Waktu",
      dataIndex: "time",
      width: 100,
      render: (v: string) => <Text strong style={{ color: "#1677ff" }}>{v}</Text>,
    },
    {
      title: "Nama Item",
      dataIndex: "itemName",
      render: (v: string, r: any) => (
        <Space direction="vertical" size={0}>
          <Text strong>{v}</Text>
          {r.size && <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{r.size}</Text>}
        </Space>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Jumlah Keluar",
      dataIndex: "quantity",
      width: 140,
      align: "right" as const,
      render: (v: number, r: any) => (
        <Text strong style={{ color: "#ff4d4f", fontSize: 14 }}>
          {formatNumber(v)} <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{r.unit}</Text>
        </Text>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Lokasi Pekerjaan",
      dataIndex: "destination",
      width: 200,
      render: (v: string | null) =>
        v ? <Tag icon={<SendOutlined />} color="cyan">{v}</Tag> : <Text type="secondary">-</Text>,
    },
    {
      title: "Pengambil (PIC)",
      dataIndex: "person",
      width: 180,
      render: (v: string) => (
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#595959" }}><UserOutlined /> {v}</Text>
      ),
    },
  ];

  let tableData: any[] = [];
  if (type === "stock") {
    tableData = (props as StockProps).dataSource;
    if (searchText) {
       tableData = tableData.filter(item => 
          item.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()) || 
          (item.size && item.size.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()))
       );
    }
  } else if (type === "outbound") {
    tableData = (props as OutboundProps).dataSource.flatMap((exit) =>
      exit.items.map((item) => ({
        ...item,
        transactionId: exit.id,
        time: exit.time,
        person: exit.person,
        destination: exit.destination,
      }))
    );
    if (searchText) {
       tableData = tableData.filter(item => 
          item.itemName.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()) || 
          (item.size && item.size.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase())) ||
          item.person.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase())
       );
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card
      variant="borderless"
      style={{ borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid #f0f0f0", overflow: "hidden" }}

      <div style={{ padding: "16px 20px", borderBottom: "1px solid #f0f0f0", background: "#fff" }}>
         <Input 
            placeholder="Cari berdasarkan nama atau ukuran..." 
            prefix={<SearchOutlined style={{ color: "#bfbfbf" }} />}
            allowClear
            size="large"
            value={searchText}
            onChange={e => setSearchText(e.target.value)}
            style={{ maxWidth: 400, borderRadius: 8 }}
         />
      </div>

      <Table
        dataSource={tableData}
        rowKey={(record: any) =>
          type === "stock" ? record.id : `${record.transactionId}-${record.itemId}`
        }
        loading={loading}
        pagination={{ pageSize: 20, size: "small", showSizeChanger: false }}
        size="middle"
        scroll={{ x: 750 }}
        columns={type === "stock" ? stockColumns : outboundColumns}
        rowClassName={(_, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? 'table-row-light' : 'table-row-dark'}
      />
      {/* Sedikit style tambahan untuk merapikan baris */}
      <style>{`
        .table-row-light { background-color: #ffffff; }
        .table-row-dark { background-color: #fafafa; }
        .ant-table-thead > tr > th { background: #f5f5f5 !important; font-weight: 600; }
      `}</style>
    </Card>
  );
};

ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/src/hooks/useDashboardStats.ts

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { getMockDashboardStats } from "../mocks/dashboard";
import type { DashboardStats } from "../types";

// ============================================
// Tipe return eksplisit
// ============================================
export interface UseDashboardStatsResult {
  stats: DashboardStats;
  isLoading: boolean;
  refetch: () => void;
}

const EMPTY_STATS: DashboardStats = {
  totalProducts: 0,
  totalStock: 0,
  todayInbound: 0,
  todayOutbound: 0,
};

export const useDashboardStats = (): UseDashboardStatsResult => {
  const query = useQuery<DashboardStats, Error, DashboardStats>({
    queryKey: ["dashboard-stats"],
    refetchInterval: USE_MOCK ? false : 60_000,
    queryFn: async (): Promise<DashboardStats> => {
      // === MODE MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        return getMockDashboardStats();
      }

      // === MODE SUPABASE ===
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];

      const [productsRes, inboundRes, outboundRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabaseClient.from(TABLES.products).select("stok"),
        supabaseClient
          .from(TABLES.stockEntries)
          .select("jumlah")
          .eq("tanggal", today),
        supabaseClient
          .from(TABLES.stockExits)
          .select("items")
          .eq("date", today),
      ]);

      if (productsRes.error) throw productsRes.error;
      if (inboundRes.error) throw inboundRes.error;
      if (outboundRes.error) throw outboundRes.error;

      const totalProducts = productsRes.data?.length ?? 0;
      const totalStock =
        productsRes.data?.reduce(
          (sum, p: { stok: number | null }) => sum + (p.stok ?? 0),
          0,
        ) ?? 0;
      const todayInbound =
        inboundRes.data?.reduce(
          (sum, e: { jumlah: number | null }) => sum + (e.jumlah ?? 0),
          0,
        ) ?? 0;

      // Hitung total quantity dari items[] di stock exits
      const todayOutbound =
        outboundRes.data?.reduce(
          (sum, exit: { items: Array<{ quantity: number }> }) =>
            sum + (exit.items?.reduce((s, i) => s + (i.quantity ?? 0), 0) ?? 0),
          0,
        ) ?? 0;

      return { totalProducts, totalStock, todayInbound, todayOutbound };
    },
  });

  return {
    stats: query.data ?? EMPTY_STATS,
    isLoading: query.isLoading,
    refetch: query.refetch,
  };
};

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number): T {
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState<T>(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, delay);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(handler);
    };
  }, [value, delay]);

  return debouncedValue;
}

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { mockWorkplaces } from "../mocks/entry";
import { usePersons } from "./usePersons";
import type { EntryLine, Person, SetupStep, Workplace } from "../types/entry";
import type { Product } from "../types";

export type EntryPhase = "search" | "quantity";

export const useEntryFlow = () => {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<SetupStep>("person");
  const [person, setPerson] = useState<Person | null>(null);
  const [workplace, setWorkplace] = useState<Workplace | null>(null);
  const [wizardOpen, setWizardOpen] = useState(false);

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<EntryPhase>("search");
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [activeQty, setActiveQty] = useState(1);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<EntryLine[]>([]);

  // ✅ Ambil data pekerja langsung dari Database
  const { persons } = usePersons();

  const wizardData = {
    person: {
      value: person,
      options: persons, // Pakai data dari DB
      placeholder: "Ketik atau pilih nama pekerja...",
      title: "Pilih Nama Pekerja",
    },
    workplace: {
      value: workplace,
      options: mockWorkplaces, // Tetap pakai hardcode lokal
      placeholder: "Ketik atau pilih lokasi pekerjaan...",
      title: "Pilih Lokasi Pekerjaan",
    },
  } as const;

  const currentWizardData =
    step === "done"
      ? { value: null, title: "", placeholder: "", options: [] }
      : wizardData[step as "person" | "workplace"];

  const openWizard = useCallback(() => {
    setStep("person");
    setWizardOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const closeWizard = useCallback(() => setWizardOpen(false), []);

  const selectWizardValue = useCallback(
    (value: Person | Workplace) => {
      if (step === "person") {
        setPerson(value as Person);
        setWorkplace(null);
        setStep("workplace");
      } else if (step === "workplace") {
        setWorkplace(value as Workplace);
        setStep("done");
        setWizardOpen(false);
      }
    },
    [step],
  );

  const resetSession = useCallback(() => {
    setStep("person");
    setPerson(null);
    setWorkplace(null);
    setPhase("search");
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setLines([]);
    setWizardOpen(false);
  }, []);

  const backWizard = useCallback(() => {
    if (step === "workplace") {
      setWorkplace(null);
      setStep("person");
    }
  }, [step]);

  const selectItem = useCallback((item: Product) => {
    setActiveItem(item);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setPhase("quantity");
  }, []);

  const confirmQuantity = useCallback(() => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    setLines((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((l) => l.itemId === activeItem.id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const copy = [...prev];
        copy[idx] = { ...copy[idx], quantity: copy[idx].quantity + activeQty };
        return copy;
      }
      return [
        ...prev,
        {
          itemId: activeItem.id,
          itemName: activeItem.name,
          unit: activeItem.unit,
          quantity: activeQty,
        },
      ];
    });
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setPhase("search");
  }, [activeItem, activeQty]);

  const cancelQuantity = useCallback(() => {
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setPhase("search");
  }, []);

  const removeLine = useCallback((itemId: number) => {
    setLines((prev) => prev.filter((l) => l.itemId !== itemId));
  }, []);

  const increaseQty = useCallback(() => setActiveQty((q) => q + 1), []);
  const decreaseQty = useCallback(
    () => setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1)),
    [],
  );

  return {
    step,
    person,
    workplace,
    currentWizardData,
    selectWizardValue,
    backWizard,
    wizardOpen,
    openWizard,
    closeWizard,
    phase,
    activeItem,
    activeQty,
    lines,
    selectItem,
    confirmQuantity,
    cancelQuantity,
    increaseQty,
    decreaseQty,
    setActiveQty,
    removeLine,
    resetSession,
    isReady: step === "done",
  };
};

import { useEffect } from "react";

interface UseKeyboardShortcutOptions {
  key: string;
  ctrlKey?: boolean;
  shiftKey?: boolean;
  altKey?: boolean;
  metaKey?: boolean;
  enabled?: boolean;
  preventDefault?: boolean;
  ignoreInputs?: boolean;
  handler: (event: KeyboardEvent) => void;
}

const isEditableElement = (el: EventTarget | null): boolean => {
  if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
  const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
  return (
    tag === "input" ||
    tag === "textarea" ||
    tag === "select" ||
    el.isContentEditable
  );
};

export const useKeyboardShortcut = ({
  key,
  ctrlKey = false,
  shiftKey = false,
  altKey = false,
  metaKey = false,
  enabled = true,
  preventDefault = true,
  ignoreInputs = false,
  handler,
}: UseKeyboardShortcutOptions) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;

    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      // Normalisasi nama key (mengabaikan case untuk huruf 'm' dan 'M')
      const isKeyMatch = event.key.toLowerCase() === key.toLowerCase() || event.key === key;
      
      if (!isKeyMatch) return;
      if (event.ctrlKey !== ctrlKey) return;
      if (event.shiftKey !== shiftKey) return;
      if (event.altKey !== altKey) return;
      if (event.metaKey !== metaKey) return;
      if (ignoreInputs && isEditableElement(event.target)) return;

      if (preventDefault) event.preventDefault();
      handler(event);
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [
    key,
    ctrlKey,
    shiftKey,
    altKey,
    metaKey,
    enabled,
    preventDefault,
    ignoreInputs,
    handler,
  ]);
};

ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/src/hooks/useMonitoringSPB.ts

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";

export interface SPBDocumentGroup {
  id: string;
  spbNo: string | null;
  poNo: string | null;
  date: string;
  status: string;
  itemsCount: number;
  sortNumber: number;
}

const getSortNumber = (str: string | null) => {
  if (!str) return 999999;
  const match = str.match(/\d+/);
  return match ? parseInt(match[0], 10) : 999999;
};

export const useMonitoringSPB = () => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<SPBDocumentGroup[]>({
    queryKey: ["monitoring-spb"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.spb)
        .select("no_spb, tanggal_pembuatan_spb, no_po, tanggal_po, status, tanggal_datang")
        .order("no_spb", { ascending: true });

      if (error) throw error;
      
      const groups: Record<string, SPBDocumentGroup> = {};
      
      (data ?? []).forEach((item: any) => {
        const key = `${item.no_spb || "NO_SPB"}_${item.no_po || "NO_PO"}`;
        
        if (!groups[key]) {
          groups[key] = {
            id: key,
            spbNo: item.no_spb,
            poNo: item.no_po,
            date: item.tanggal_pembuatan_spb || item.tanggal_po || item.tanggal_datang || "-",
            status: item.status,
            itemsCount: 0,
            sortNumber: getSortNumber(item.no_spb) + (getSortNumber(item.no_po) * 0.01),
          };
        }
        
        // Aturan status: Jika ada satupun barang yang BELUM DATANG, status card adalah BELUM DATANG
        if (item.status === "BELUM DATANG") {
          groups[key].status = "BELUM DATANG";
        }
        
        groups[key].itemsCount += 1;
      });

      return Object.values(groups);
    },
  });

  return {
    data: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};

FILE: src/hooks/useProductSearch.ts
ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/src/hooks/useProductSearch.ts
====================================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockProducts } from "../mocks/products";
import { mapProduct } from "../utility/mappers";
import type { Product } from "../types";

export const useProductSearch = (keyword: string, limit = 30) => { // ✅ FIX 6: Limit dinaikkan ke 30
  // ✅ FIX 3: Sanitize input (Hapus karakter liar %, _, (, ) dll yang bikin query error)
  const sanitize = (str: string) => str.replace(/[%_()\\'"]/g, "");
  const trimmed = sanitize(keyword).trim();

  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<Product[]>({
    queryKey: ["product-search", trimmed, limit],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150));
        if (!trimmed) return mockProducts.slice(0, limit);
        const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        return mockProducts
          .filter(
            (p) =>
              p.name.toLowerCase().includes(lower) ||
              p.code.toLowerCase().includes(lower),
          )
          .slice(0, limit);
      }

      let query = supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.products)
        .select("*")
        .limit(limit)
        // ✅ FIX 5: .order() agar hasil tidak acak dan relevance bagus
        .order("nama", { ascending: true }); 

      if (trimmed) {
        // ✅ FIX 2: Split per kata, jadikan OR.
        // Hasilnya: nama.ilike.%kata1%,kode.ilike.%kata1%,nama.ilike.%kata2%...
        // Agar multi-kata atau urutan terbalik tetap matching.
        const words = trimmed.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        const orConditions = words
          .map((w) => `nama.ilike.%${w}%,kode.ilike.%${w}%`)
          .join(",");
        
        query = query.or(orConditions);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;
      return (data ?? []).map(mapProduct);
    },
    staleTime: 10_000,
  });

  return {
    products: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};

ABSOLUTE PATH: /home/ramzboy/vscode/projects/admin-stok/src/hooks/useProducts.ts
